title: Leveraging Scaffold Information to Predict Protein-ligand Binding Affinity with an Empirical Graph Neural Network
authors: Chunqiu Xia; Shi-Hao Feng; Ying Xia; Xiaoyong Pan; Hong-Bin Shen
one_liner_zh: 该文用图神经网络预测蛋白-配体结合亲和力，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-配体互作建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Motivation Protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is an important task in structural bioinformatics for drug discovery and design. Although various scoring functions have been proposed, it remains challenging to accurately evaluate the binding affinity of a protein-ligand complex with known bound structure due to the potential preference of scoring system. In recent years, deep learning techniques have been applied to scoring functions without sophisticated feature engineering. Nevertheless, existing methods cannot model the differential contribution of atoms in various regions of proteins, and the relationship between atom properties and intermolecular distance is also not fully explored. Results We propose a novel empirical graph neural network for accurate protein-ligand binding affinity prediction (EGNA). Graphs of protein, ligand and their interactions are constructed based on different regions of each bound complex. Proteins and ligands are effectively represented by graph convolutional layers, enabling the EGNA to capture interaction patterns precisely by simulating empirical scoring functions. The contributions of different factors on binding affinity can thus be transparently investigated. EGNA is compared with the state-of-the-art machine learning-based scoring functions on two widely used benchmark datasets. The results demonstrate the superiority of EGNA and its good generalization capability. Availability and implementation The web server and source code of EGNA is available at www.csbio.sjtu.edu.cn/bioinf/EGNA and https://github.com/chunqiux/EGNA . Contact hbshen@sjtu.edu.cn or 2008xypan@sjtu.edu.cn Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
abstract_zh: 动机 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测是结构生物信息学中药物发现与设计的重要任务。尽管已提出多种评分函数，但由于评分系统可能存在的偏好，准确评估已知结合结构的蛋白质-配体复合物的结合亲和力仍具挑战性。近年来，深度学习技术已被应用于无需复杂特征工程的评分函数。然而，现有方法无法模拟蛋白质不同区域原子的差异性贡献，且原子性质与分子间距离之间的关系也未得到充分探索。结果 我们提出了一种新颖的经验图神经网络用于准确的蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测（EGNA）。基于每个结合复合物的不同区域构建蛋白质、配体及其相互作用的图。通过图卷积层有效表示蛋白质和配体，使EGNA能够通过模拟经验评分函数精确捕获相互作用模式。因此，不同因素对结合亲和力的贡献可以被透明地研究。EGNA与最先进的基于机器学习的评分函数在两个广泛使用的基准数据集上进行了比较。结果表明EGNA的优越性及其良好的泛化能力。可用性与实现 EGNA的Web服务器和源代码可在www.csbio.sjtu.edu.cn/bioinf/EGNA和https://github.com/chunqiux/EGNA获取。联系方式 hbshen@sjtu.edu.cn或2008xypan@sjtu.edu.cn 补充信息 补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。
